summary: The OAuth Guide Agent build is correct, complete, and faithful to design.md revision 3 and requirements.md (ACs 1-25). I verified it by running the project's real build/test commands from context.json, not grep: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs (exit 0); npm --prefix backend run build (tsc clean) and npm --prefix backend test (115/115 passing, including the four deployFiles tests for ACs 23/25); npm --prefix frontend run build (exit 0, zero TS errors, HeroScene split into its own lazy chunk and landing bundle under the 250KB-gz budget) and npm --prefix frontend test (38/38 passing); node scripts/check-links.mjs (exit 0, 50 URLs ok=46 redirected=4 blocked=0 broken=0 for AC 3, the 4 redirects being benign geo/login-gated URLs); git grep for sk-/tvly- key shapes returns nothing (AC 25); and node submission/build-pdf.mjs --draft produces a 1.68MB PDF (<10MB) passing every guard (AC 24). All three design-review findings are physically present in source and covered by tests: finding #1 two-phase PDF token replacement in submission/build-pdf.mjs (block tokens deferred past marked, inline tokens escaped, loud guards on leftover tokens/escaped block HTML), finding #2 normalization in backend/src/agent/postprocess.ts (normalizeVerification + empty-optional->undefined + verifier-note-only-when-lowered), and finding #3 repair-retry in backend/src/agent/pipeline.ts (assembleGuide(verification:null) probe, at most one repair capped by the attempts guard -> LLM_FAILED, verification run exactly once, DraftInvalid caught by instanceof). The NIT fixes (rateLimitMax in /api/health, single input message, CONFIG_MISSING stub deps, vitest React plugin, stream terminal-event handling, Loom-absence base64 stripping, alias coverage for 'Microsoft Entra ID'/'Atlassian Jira', README one-command-per-line) are also in place. The only open item is informational and out of the builder's control: the submission PDF is a draft because submission/links.config.json still holds YOUR- placeholders for the live Vercel/Render/repo URLs, which per requirements A2 the user supplies after deploying and then re-runs node submission/build-pdf.mjs for the final PDF. No blocking concerns remain. Full review document: .agents/tasks/2026-10-23-030410-review.md.
